Explicit Auto/manual/eligibility/stream/source/output negatives; actual parent/child and cross-Space aggregate contention; max3 coordinated retries; prepare/claim/accept/settle crash and lost-COMMIT schedules; both lookup/accept/seal and Stop orderings; recreated native/adapter processes; waits/top-up/resource interval/overrun conservation; checker sabotage and protected baseline/evidence guards; six local operator journeys. Five external gates remain pending with exact future approval/qualification conditions. Independent/controller evidence audits are separate noncircular post-run gates. Documentation audit passed 100 IDs/65 cases/all fields/links/solution hash; no production code, product tests, protected edits or external calls.

Controller job-484e02b90b passes unchanged identity35/foundation17/G0 197/local72 and protected597/raw88/foundation42 guards; complete six stream bytes/SHA256 indexed with pre-document fingerprint. No production code or accepted input edited. Document records all implementation owners and E01-E05 external qualification gates. Controller made approval blocking despite requested nonblocking; local resources ready, workflow waiting on human. Readiness documentation audit passed and owned temp install/probes removed.

plan_review.findings: No blocking solution, test-design, task-plan or local-readiness gaps found. Sources and stage documents were independently read. The chosen additive PG/native composition preserves one authority per record, current F01/F02 scope and F03 fences, complete eligible operating profiles, atomic shared reservation, coordinated retries and original-owner unknown-usage reconciliation; real supplier/billing/runtime claims remain deferred. Test-plan.md §§4–6 maps all100 reviewed requirements to65 mandatory assertion-backed cases across eight suites, including actual PG blockers/partial-write rollback, both acceptance/Stop and seal/accept orders, crash/recreated-process recovery, no-replay counters and negative qualification sabotage. Controller tasks f04-01–16 cover every requirement without extra IDs, have acyclic dependencies and appropriate single-lead roles/team=[]; actual component/slice/build/aggregate checks execute behavior and fail closed. Readiness R01–R17 supplies concrete pinned offline compiler/dependency/PG/identity/loopback/process/controller probes; current q-6e6222040b resolves historical R18 only for the exact inherited read-only regression. docs/planning/g1-f04-plan.md:819–837 and f04-16 concretely cover PROD-F04-001: proposed choice/profile/refusal and encoded estimate are explicit, saved accounting historical, preview mutations forbidden. Actual authenticated J02 regression helper asserts independent exact profile-byte cost, positive/unavailable/ineligible/equivalent/unsupported/null variants and unchanged full durable snapshots/counters. Existing controller mutation job-cccba81605 fails all5 new preview subtests plus parent J02; completed task job-792b1cc3e3 passes targeted20/20 and full2454/2454 with all65 mandatory identities. Independently verified151 current input hashes and1733 preserved hashes. These observations support plan/check soundness; they do not substitute for the fresh original four-command current-candidate verification, complete additive evidence indexing and independent/final/product gates. Original acceptance definitions and strict runtime guards remain unchanged; original-command controller environment must select installed Node22.22.3. E01–E05 remain unqualified. No changes requested for this plan gate.
